package.name: tracking
package.description:
THE CANONICAL TRACK CONTRACT — the single seam every perception producer emits and the IT2-FLS controller consumes. `Track` (track.py) is a frozen stdlib dataclass carrying position, velocity, heading, uncertainty (pos_std/vel_std, which the interval type-2 fuzzifier needs) and staleness.
Also ships the framework-agnostic tracker that turns per-frame Detection3D into Tracks: data association + constant-velocity Kalman + lifecycle.
DELIBERATELY DEPENDENCY-FREE: pure Python stdlib. No rclpy, no numpy, no fusion_lab. That is what lets one type survive Foxy (robot) / Humble (dev) / Jazzy (lab) unchanged, and it is why the sim and hardware paths can stay interface-identical. Do not add dependencies to this package.
